surface.name: OpenRouter unified Chat Completions API via cURL
surface.selection_basis: OpenRouter's quickstart calls its standard HTTP endpoint the most direct integration and provides a cURL request with no SDK dependency.

alternatives_considered.name: OpenRouter client SDK
alternatives_considered.reason_not_primary: It adds a package dependency over the same API.

alternatives_considered.name: OpenAI SDK compatibility
alternatives_considered.reason_not_primary: It is useful for migration but not required for the first HTTP result.

entry_point.developer_intent: Create an OpenRouter API key, choose a routed model, and receive generated text from the unified endpoint.
assumed_prior_state: A browser and cURL are available.

documented_first_success.normalized_outcome: An authenticated OpenRouter Chat Completions request returns model-generated content.
documented_first_success.observable_completion_signal: The response contains an assistant choice from the selected or routed model.

boundary_evidence.official_label_or_terminal_state: The quickstart provides a direct cURL POST to /api/v1/chat/completions.

documented_first_success.why_this_is_the_boundary: The first generated completion completes the router API job, while provider selection, fallbacks, and attribution remain separate routing concerns.

prerequisites.requirement: An OpenRouter account able to create an API key.
A model slug or router selection.
An HTTPS client such as cURL.

primary_path.action: Create or sign in to an OpenRouter account.
primary_path.failure_or_wait: Signup fields are not enumerated in the API quickstart.

primary_path.action: Create and store an OpenRouter API key.
primary_path.success_signal: The key is available to cURL.

primary_path.action: Choose the quickstart model alias or another catalog slug.
details: Optional app-attribution headers do not affect basic authentication.
primary_path.success_signal: A valid model value is selected.
primary_path.failure_or_wait: Availability, price, and provider policy can vary by model.

primary_path.action: POST messages to https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions with the Bearer key.
primary_path.success_signal: The API returns an assistant choice.
primary_path.failure_or_wait: Credential, credit, model, provider, or rate-limit errors block output.

primary_path.action: Confirm that the response contains generated assistant content.
primary_path.failure_or_wait: An error body does not meet the boundary.

friction_gates.description: An OpenRouter API key is required.
The developer must select a model or router, and the platform may select an underlying provider.

uncertainties.question: Which funding path is shortest for a brand-new account at the time of review?
uncertainties.impact: Free-model availability versus purchased credits changes the payment gate.
uncertainties.reason_unresolved: The quickstart delegates free-model and rate-limit details to separate changing guidance.
